latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing AI Agent — fast, automated video editing for creators.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB for AI-driven editing and export.
- Describe edits in natural language (e.g., "cut the pauses, add transitions"), and get polished clips in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic backend session handling, authentication, and error management.
- Supports exporting high-quality MP4s and accessing session state, credits, and batch uploads.
- Designed for rapid workflow: upload, describe, export — no technical editing skills required.
